cards.text: Moses has died, and the LORD has told Joshua, Moses' assistant, to cross over the Jordan with all the people into the land (Joshua 1:1-2). Now, from Shittim, Joshua secretly sends out two spies. His orders: “Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.”

cards.question: The two spies slip into Jericho and stay at a house there. Whose house is it?

cards.text: Word gets to the king of Jericho: men of Israel came tonight to spy out the land. That's like sneaking into work late and finding your boss standing RIGHT at the door.

cards.question: The king of Jericho sends a message to Rahab about the spies. What does he tell her to do?

answers.text: Bring the men out to him
Keep the men inside her house
Send the men out of town

cards.question: True or false: Rahab hands the two spies over to the king's men.

cards.text: Rahab had already hidden them. She tells the king's men yes, the men came, but she didn't know where they came from, and they left at dusk right before the gate closed.

cards.question: Rahab tells the king's men she doesn't know which way the spies went. What does she tell them to do?

answers.text: Wait for them at the gate

cards.text: But here's the truth. Rahab had taken them up to her roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax she had laid out there.

The king's men take off after the spies along the road to the fords of the Jordan. I bet those two up on the roof are holding their breath, like I did every time somebody rattled open that junk drawer I got stuck in.

cards.question: True or false: As soon as the king's men go out of Jericho after the spies, the city gate is shut.

cards.text: Before the spies lie down for the night, Rahab climbs up to the roof. And she's got something to say.

cards.question: Up on the roof, Rahab tells the spies something she knows. What is it?

answers.text: The LORD has given Israel the land
The king will find them by morning
Jericho's walls can never be broken

cards.question: True or false: Rahab says everyone who lives in the land is melting in fear of Israel.

cards.text: Then Rahab tells them what Jericho has heard. The LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before Israel when they came out of Egypt.

cards.question: Rahab also names Sihon and Og, two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan. What does she say Israel did to them?

answers.text: Made a peace treaty with them
Let them flee across the river

cards.text: When Jericho heard all that, their hearts melted and everyone's courage failed. It's like watching two coworkers walk out of the boss's office looking pale, and you're NEXT.

cards.question: Then Rahab says something big about the LORD, Israel's God. What does she say He is?

answers.text: God in heaven above and on earth below
God over Israel and no one else
The strongest of all the gods

cards.text: Now Rahab asks the spies to swear by the LORD. She showed them kindness, so she asks them to show kindness back, and she wants a sure sign.

cards.question: Rahab asks the spies to spare the lives of her ___ and deliver them from death.
True or false: The spies agree to show Rahab kindness if she doesn't report their mission.

cards.text: Now the spies need a way out of Jericho. Lucky for them, Rahab's house is built right into the city wall.

cards.question: Rahab's house is built into Jericho's wall. She lets the spies down through the window by a ___.

cards.text: Out the window and down a rope, no stairs, just a WHOLE lot of trust. And before they go, Rahab gives them a plan.

cards.question: The king's men are out on the road to the Jordan. Where does Rahab tell the spies to hide?

answers.text: By the fords of the Jordan

cards.question: Rahab tells the spies to stay hidden there for a while before going on their way. Until when?

answers.text: Until the gate opens at dawn

cards.text: Then the spies set their terms. They won't be bound by the oath unless Rahab does two things when Israel enters the land.

cards.question: The spies' first condition: what does Rahab have to tie in the window she let them down through?
True or false: The spies' other condition is that Rahab brings her father and mother and brothers and all her family into her house.

cards.text: And they spell it out: anyone who goes out the door into the street is on his own, but if anyone inside with Rahab is harmed, that's on the spies. And if she reports their mission, the oath is off.

cards.question: The spies have laid out all their terms. How does Rahab answer them?

cards.text: She says, “Let it be as you say,” and she sends them away.

cards.question: True or false: Rahab waits until Israel arrives to tie the scarlet cord in her window.

cards.text: The spies hide in the hill country for three days while their pursuers search all along the road. I did YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, so three days sounds like a vacation to me.

cards.question: True or false: The pursuers come back without finding the spies.

cards.text: Then the two men come down from the hill country, cross the river and head back to Joshua. They report all that happened to them.

cards.question: The spies tell Joshua, “The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands.” They add that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of Israel. Who in Jericho told them nearly the same thing?

cards.text: Two spies, one roof, a pile of flax and a scarlet cord in a window. And friend, this story is NOT done yet.
